capabilities: Render \cite{key} and [@key] citations as numbered internal links
Complete citation keys by key or title while typing
Generate a bibliography at a \bibliography marker
Parse BibTeX entries from fenced bibtex blocks in a reference folder
Reindex citations when reference notes are created, edited, moved, or deleted
extras: Not yet accepted into the community plugin directory; beta installs go through BRAT or manual download. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Works entirely offline with no network requests or account. Some Pandoc citation features (locators, prefixes, suffixes, suppressed author) are not yet supported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render citations or bibliographies from BibTeX entries stored in notes.
summary: Citation renderer that turns LaTeX \cite{key} or Pandoc [@key] citations into internal links to reference notes holding BibTeX, with key completion and a generated bibliography.
